name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib,datetime
p=Path.cwd()
def w(n,s):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
frozen=json.loads((p/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert frozen['count']==12 and not frozen['mismatches']
receipts=[]
for q in sorted(p.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(q.read_text());receipts.append({'path':q.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exit':r.get('exit'),'killed':r.get('killed'),'wall_s':r.get('wall_s'),'child_cpu_cumulative_s':r.get('child_cpu_cumulative_s'),'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':r.get('sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'),'samples':r.get('samples'),'affinity':r.get('affinity')});assert r.get('exit')==0 and r.get('killed') is None
boot=json.loads((p/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_text())
w('resource-inventory.json',json.dumps({'completed_runner_receipts':receipts,'bootstrap_receipt':{'path':'bootstrap-receipt.json','sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'bootstrap-receipt.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'record':boot},'standalone_before':json.loads((p/'frozen-before.json').read_text()),'standalone_after':frozen,'pending_terminal_runner_receipt':'terminal_manifest.receipt.json (generated after this child exits; explicitly excluded from self-hashing snapshot)','limits_and_caveats':'Runner actual limits unchanged; sampled groupRSS misses transients; separate writer and native tool RSS/CPU unavailable; no universal cgroup/process claim; all observed prior local subprocesses reaped; true exits retained'},indent=2))
exclude={'SHA256-MANIFEST.json':'Manifest cannot hash itself without circularity','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'Runner emits this after manifest child exits; command includes manifest-producing code','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'Runner emits this after child exits and contains manifest digest'}
files=[]
for q in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if not q.is_file():continue
 rel=str(q.relative_to(p))
 if rel in exclude:continue
 assert not q.is_symlink()
 b=q.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
manifest={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'algorithm':'SHA256','scope':'All own-lane files present after frozen-after and inventory completion, including every completed nonterminal receipt JSON','files':files,'named_noncircular_terminal_self_exclusions':exclude,'credit':0,'frozen_after':'12 bindings, no mismatches'}
w('SHA256-MANIFEST.json',json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
for v in files:assert hashlib.sha256((p/v['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v['sha256']
print(json.dumps({'manifest':'SHA256-MANIFEST.json','sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/'SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files_hashed':len(files),'completed_runner_receipts_hashed':len(receipts),'bootstrap_receipt_hashed':True,'frozen_after':frozen,'self_exclusions':exclude,'all_prior_runner_exits':0,'credit':0},indent=2))
